originalGroup.title: Collecting an online purchase
originalGroup.passage:
Woman: I received a message saying my order is ready for pickup, but I cannot find the confirmation number.
Man: I can search by the phone number used for the order. Could you also show a photo ID?
Woman: Sure. I ordered a desk lamp and a notebook. Is everything here?
Man: The lamp is here. The notebook will arrive tomorrow, and we will send a separate notification.
originalGroup.passageZh:
女：我收到訂單可以取貨的訊息，但找不到確認編號。
男：我可以用訂購時的電話號碼搜尋。也請出示附照片的證件，可以嗎？
女：可以。我訂了桌燈和筆記本。東西都到了嗎？
男：桌燈到了。筆記本明天會到，我們會另外發通知。
